reviews.title: Best baby related app
reviews.contents: This app is brilliant for tracking pumping sessions and for your milk stash. With my other two pumping journeys I faffed around with apps which had ads and never quite did what I needed and had to manually log my freezer stash and work out how much I needed etc. this app does it for you and it’s brilliant. Seeing your own pumping data is super satisfying too. The widget and timer is helpful for when you’re busy. It’s clear and easy to use and I’ve never had a bug or worry with it. Worth every penny if you’re exclusively pumping for sure.

reviews.title: Life changing for you and your little
reviews.contents: Honestly I’m so pleased I found this app. I’m exclusively pumping and this is a game changer. I feel in control of my pumping and really enjoyed seeing how much I have saved so far in not buying fomular. I did pay to upgrade, however it is worth it as having unlimted logs is great. I feel confident in knowing how much my baby is having and it has encouraged me to continue. I am on month 4, wish I knew about it sooner. Found it when I was week 4. My insta is 1st_time_ma happy to answer any question, love it!

reviews.title: Best app to support my EP journey
reviews.contents: If you are exclusively pumping then do not hesitate to purchase this app. This was a complete game changer for me allowing me to keep track of my pump schedule and volumes ensuring I was managing any oversupply or dips effectively. It provides a simple way of recording exactly what you need and the reminders are there to keep you on track. The recent addition of a calculator to the app was a welcome update for a tired mama. I cannot recommend this app enough. Thank you.

reviews.title: Exclusively Pumping must have
reviews.contents: Stop trying to remember when & how much you pumped in the last session. Use the widget in home page to keep track of session. App calculates when you can stop pumping to use frozen stash to make it to your goal. Basically, if you are EPumping, do yourself a favor and stop overthinking this. Get the app. Only way Ive made it to 8months already.

reviews.title: The epitome of apps
reviews.contents: It's so seldom that any app developer gets it perfect. This app is just perfect - it has exactly the features you need and nothing else. Other apps are too complex or too simple - many don't display the information you need in the main view. I could not be happier. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Brilliant to establish exclusive pumping
reviews.contents: I found this app really good for helping me to know how I was doing establishing a good milk supply through exclusively pumping. Did exactly what I wanted it too and so easy to use! Would highly recommend, especially if you need to keep track of supply for a premature baby in special care.

reviews.title: Fantastic app
reviews.contents:
I wish more apps were like this! 

Perfect for what I need and I am still using it 9 months later. I’ve purchased expensive apps for my sons sleep and feeding schedules but have continued to use this for my pumping because I love it’s no frills approach. 

The widget is fantastic! I love that it’s always there and the reminders the app sends are a good reminder. 

Its not easy exclusively pumping for a little one but this has made my life so much easier. I’m so glad I found it and would recommend to anyone.

reviews.title: Love love love
reviews.contents: This has given me such control over my pumping. I don’t have time to remember when to pump next so this app is an absolute time saver. I love that it tells me my daily avarage so I can make sure I’m not losing my supply. Just love it!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.contents: Such a great app to track when i pump and the amounts! Also love that you can see how much more you need for baby until you finish pumping!

reviews.title: The best app I have
reviews.contents:
This app has been so important in me sustaining my EP journey! It tracks daily pumps, totals the amount, shows trends on which day was best, months etc. 
I wish I discovered it sooner!
